title.es: Galeón Venganza de la Reina Ana

generated.description: A large sailing galleon named after the pirate ship Queen Anne's Revenge, built mostly from spruce, oak, dark oak and jungle wood with black and blue terracotta and black wool accents. It is about 36 blocks wide, 74 high and 85 deep, sitting on a block of water, and it has no block entities, so there are no working chests or furnaces inside. Its hull is tall and layered, with stacked decks and masts visible from the front view.
